_comment: CAT-BOOTSTRAP, declared as an INSTANTIATED harness. Owner, 2026-09-21: '4 and boot strap, cat harness and folioasistant should be instantaited'. It is the floor -- its own `renderExemption` says 'bootstrap IS the navbar footer' -- and being the floor is not the same as being absent: it is instantiated here, it sorts last, and its tile is the one that says what the stack rests on. `contentType` is `document` because bootstrap holds structured prose an agent reads before anything else is installed; it carries no Lean and no TeX, so the paper adapter's axes would fire on content that never reaches pdflatex.
